name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Business loan support for shops, repair work, tailoring and other small enterprises.
amountLabel: Up to ₹20 lakh. Tarun Plus above ₹10 lakh is only for people who have repaid a previous Tarun loan successfully.
bestFor: Small shops, tailoring, repair, services and other micro businesses.
benefits: Loan for business stock, equipment or day-to-day business needs.
No collateral is required under the scheme.
requirements: A business activity that can earn income.
The lender checks your documents and repayment ability.
eligibility: For eligible non-corporate micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, services and allied agriculture activities. The lender makes the final decision.
documents: Any extra documents requested by the lender
applicationSteps: Choose a lender that offers MUDRA loans.
Ask which MUDRA category fits your business amount.
Submit your business details and documents.
Check the lender's final terms before accepting.
sourceName: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
source_name: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Small working-money support for street vendors to buy stock and continue their business.
amountLabel: Up to ₹15,000 first, then ₹25,000 and ₹50,000 after successful repayment of the earlier loan.
bestFor: Street vendors, hawkers and small mobile sellers.
benefits: Interest subsidy for regular repayment, subject to scheme rules.
Digital-payment rewards may be available under current scheme rules.
requirements: You must be an eligible street vendor.
A Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation may be needed.
eligibility: For eligible street vendors. The next loan step depends on repaying the earlier step successfully. The official authority and lender decide eligibility.
documents: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation
applicationSteps: Check your vendor document with your Town Vending Committee or local body.
Visit the official PM SVANidhi portal or a participating lender.
Apply for the appropriate loan step.
Read the lender's repayment terms before accepting.
sourceName: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans for eligible entrepreneurs starting a new business.
amountLabel: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for a new eligible business.
bestFor: Eligible SC/ST and women entrepreneurs starting a new business, subject to the scheme rules.
benefits: Bank loan for a new business in manufacturing, services, trading or allied agriculture.
Guidance and support are available through the official portal.
requirements: Woman entrepreneur or SC/ST entrepreneur eligibility.
The bank checks the business plan and its own lending conditions.
eligibility: For eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield enterprise. It is not an automatic approval; the bank makes the final decision.
documents: Identity and category documents where applicable
Quotations or other documents requested by the bank
applicationSteps: Check the scheme conditions on Stand-Up Mitra.
Prepare a simple business plan and cost estimate.
Contact a participating bank or use the portal for guidance.
Confirm the bank's final terms and documents.
sourceName: Stand-Up Mitra / Department of Financial Services, Government of India
source_name: Stand-Up Mitra / Department of Financial Services, Government of India

name: Explore Maharashtra MSME Support
description: Find current Maharashtra Government MSME support, training and service information for your business.
amountLabel: Check the current official programme. This is a support-information card, not one loan scheme.
bestFor: Entrepreneurs in Maharashtra who want verified state support information.
benefits: Official Maharashtra MSME support and service information.
A place to find current programmes before applying.
requirements: Requirements depend on the programme you choose.
Check the official site or District Industries Centre before applying.
eligibility: This card does not decide or promise eligibility. Each Maharashtra programme has its own current rules.
documents: Keep identity, business and bank documents ready if a chosen programme asks for them.
applicationSteps: Open the official Maharashtra MSME support site.
Choose the programme or service that matches your business.
Read the current rules and contact the relevant office or District Industries Centre.
sourceName: Maharashtra Small Scale Industries Development Corporation, Government of Maharashtra
source_name: Maharashtra Small Scale Industries Development Corporation, Government of Maharashtra
department: Maharashtra Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
